item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 16/Sep/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An upper-air disturbance will bring a few showers to the coast of Guangdong and the northern part of the South China Sea today. An area of low pressure may develop within the broad trough of low pressure over the central part of the South China Sea to the seas east of the Philippines in the next couple of days, and move towards Hainan Island. With the broad trough of low pressure edging northwards to the coast of southern China, there will be more showers with squally thunderstorms over the region in the latter part of this week. Besides, a tropical cyclone is expected to form over the western North Pacific to the east of the Philippines in the latter part of this week. It will move towards the vicinity of Luzon early next week, with a higher chance of entering the northern part of the South China Sea subsequently.
